adds.title: Criminal Code s.159 repeal via Bill C-32 / Bill C-75
adds.summary: Assented 2019-06-21, S.C. 2019, c. 25 repealed Criminal Code section 159 criminalizing anal intercourse and barred conviction for any historical sexual offence unless the act would constitute an offence if committed on the day the charge was laid, eliminating criminal liability in Nunavut for consensual conduct previously captured by the repealed provision.
